brief: BRIEF-6 (rename to Disaster Mapping, flood time steps, clearer 3D flood view, dimming off by default)
summary: The app is renamed Disaster Mapping in everything a person sees (logo text, page titles, document.title, top bars, every UI string in web/src, backend messages, notes, caveats, credits, API and CLI descriptions, and the outgoing User-Agent 'Disaster-Mapping/0.1 (research prototype)'), with internal names kept (fire3d package, FIRE3D_* settings, URL parameters, storage keys, CSS classes, ids, file names) and two new guards (web: TypeScript AST scan of strings, templates and JSX text plus the HTML pages; backend: tokenize scan of every string). The zoom-following globe vignette is now off by default: a 'Zoom dimming' switch in a new Display section of both Layers & settings drawers (fires and floods) turns it on, remembered in this browser (localStorage 'fire3d.zoomDimming', wrapped in try/catch, off when storage is unavailable); the edge gradients behind text are unchanged. The longer name needed the Forensic bar's brand word to hide up to 1720 px (was 1400) so the place and date lines stay whole on laptops. README.md is new, written for a newcomer (glossary, official/measured/experimental, the three views for fires and floods, Mac step by step, known limits, every existing credit line, docs map, About the name); CLAUDE.md (name only), docs/validation.md, docs/cloud/SETUP.md, environment-setup.sh and dev.sh now use the new name and repository.
milestones: M1 rename in every user-facing string, guards, fixtures, CONTRACT strings (17f0d6b)
M2 zoom dimming off by default with a 'Zoom dimming' switch (code in the wave-1 snapshot 126ba1d; screenshots and progress 302bfe5)
M3 new README, CLAUDE.md name, current docs, as-built note, report (92b2835)

Count-only secret scan of the M1 staged diff: FIRMS_MAP_KEY 0, EARTHDATA_TOKEN not set here.
known_issues: Flood bundles prepared before the rename keep 'Fire-3d' in stored notes (the satellite login note in data/floods/*/manifest.json and satellite.json; 27 files here, and the fixture server's canned answers in data/floods/*/api/) until prepared again (make_fixture.py --only flood; re-prepare real floods). The Forensic flood screenshot shows it. Optionally api/floods.py (backend-flood-time-3d) could replace the old name in stored notes when serving.
README screenshots (brief4-final-*, brief5-final-*) still show 'Fire-3d' in the top bar; the README says so. Re-shoot in the final check if wanted.
README's flood Command and Forensic paragraphs describe brief-5 behaviour; the playback controls and the 3D flood view of brief 6 should be added once built (final check or those roles).
On a 390 px phone the Public flood title's date line 'SEEN BY DISASTER MAPPING SINCE NOV 4 2026' wraps to three lines (no overlap with the water circle).
The Forensic bar hides the brand word up to 1720 px (was 1400); the logo mark stays.

backend/fire3d/data/gazetteer_us.json keeps 'Fire-3d' in its (unserved) note until rebuilt with scripts/build_gazetteer.py; .claude/hooks/cloud_install.sh (configuration) keeps the old name in a comment and an echo.
M1's commit 17f0d6b had one wrong regex in web/src/location/FloodReadout.test.ts (the User-Agent substitution hit a regex ending in 'Fire-3d/'); fixed in the wave-1 snapshot 126ba1d.
notes_for_others: backend-flood-time-3d / final-check: stored flood notes keep the old name until re-prepared (see known issues). final-check: README flood sections need the brief-6 playback and 3D view lines; the dimming switch is window.__workspace.getState().setZoomDimming(true) for screenshots; test guards web/src/lib/productName.test.ts and backend/tests/test_product_name.py fail on 'Fire-3d' in any new string.
